reviews.text: Wonderful service. Kind and caring towards our furry friends.
They were very attentive and extremely available to explain treatments and procedures. Kika appreciates all the care.
5-star clinic. I recommend it.

We left the cat for sterilization in the morning, at 1:30 PM we were back to pick up the cat, the operation went well, as the cat is already feeling well at home. She drinks, eats, plays, the wounds are healing.

Thanks to the kindness of Dr. João and Mrs. Adelaide, my cat recovered and is doing well. They discovered the problem, treated it quickly and effectively, and since my Mimi was very nervous and scared, everything went very well. Always available and with good prices. Thank you very much.

Dr. João and Adelaide are always ready to help, super friendly and professional, they have always taken very good care of my dogs. It's a peaceful place for the furry friends. I've been a client for over twenty years and I highly recommend them.

For me, a terrible experience that I won't repeat.
It started badly as soon as I left my cat. The environment had a nauseating smell, I left my cat on the counter inside the carrier, and I wasn't even introduced to the doctor, nor was I allowed to accompany her at the beginning of the sterilization process. However, I gave them the benefit of the doubt due to the excellent ratings here on Google.

They called me to pick her up about 5 hours later. Since I wasn't nearby, I asked them to wait. They only gave me about 1 hour and 30 minutes so the animal wouldn't get stressed. When I arrived, my cat was still trapped inside the carrier, I believe, since the end of the surgery. The clinic lacks the structure for hospitalization and recovery. I requested that she be fitted with a post-surgical vest because I know my cat well enough to know that she wouldn't accept the Elizabethan collar. The doctor refused and stuck the collar on her. They said it was a price. I paid double with all the extras (including the collar) that they put on without informing me. I had to run around the streets to withdraw money because there isn't even an ATM.
During the surgery, I called several times to find out how she was doing. The receptionist answered all the calls. She never gave me a single piece of information.
I got home, slowly let my cat out, and she fell. Still under the effects of anesthesia. When she got up, she ripped off the collar. She wouldn't let us put it back on because she's very restless.
We had to go to another veterinarian to put the vest on her and monitor the surgical wound, which already looked very bad.
It took about a month for her to recover 100%, and the TERRIBLE smell that came from my cat only went away after a good bath.

Never again!!!
Excellent service during my kitten's neutering, from the reception staff to Dr. João.
Amazing people and Vets people who really loves supporting the community,  supper recommended♡
Professionalism and friendliness.
What a spectacle! This veterinarian truly loves what he does.

I took my kitten to be neutered today and I couldn't have received better care, from the receptionist to the doctors themselves. Extremely attentive and careful. Complete post-surgery information. My kitten is as good as new. A big thank you to the clinic and to the Porto Cats Association.
Incredible

Good afternoon, I took a cat I found in the street to the vet today and received spectacular care, and the vet was also fantastic.

I would like to thank the Porto Cats Project for their attention. Thank you very much.
Attentive and demonstrates knowledge in his field.

My cat was spayed here and I loved the service and all the care they took in explaining the necessary aftercare at home. The cat had no complications and started eating well that same evening. Thank you!
I really appreciated the doctor's careful explanations and the friendly way we were received.
Very attentive and friendly.
Top works very well.
Super friendly and professional.
Petizca with Z thanks you.
